Preserve the controller modality: a structured measurement must name a registered deterministic function that exactly matches it (if none matches, report the capability gap instead of recasting it as LLM); a narrative predicate must declare the LLM skill modality. Return exactly {"spec": {...}}. cited_evidence preserves whole source units: fact exact_span; document/event read_windows[].readable_text with raw coordinates and case scope; relation fact_refs resolve to included operands. Only executed read windows establish narrative support; titles are navigation. content_hash/verbatim_hash bind original raw source, not projected readable_text. Infer no unread body or metadata.
